questions.q: A solid sphere, a solid cylinder, and a ring of the same mass and radius are released from the top of an incline simultaneously. In what order will they reach the bottom?
questions.qPa: ਇੱਕ ਠੋਸ ਗੋਲਾ, ਇੱਕ ਠੋਸ ਸਿਲੰਡਰ, ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਰਿੰਗ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਪੁੰਜ ਅਤੇ ਅਰਧ-ਵਿਆਸ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਹੈ, ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਢਲਾਨ ਦੇ ਸਿਖਰ ਤੋਂ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਛੱਡਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਉਹ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹੁੰਚਣਗੇ?
questions.explanation: Acceleration is inversely proportional to (1 + k²/R²). The solid sphere has the smallest k²/R² (2/5), so it accelerates the fastest. The ring has the largest (1), so it is slowest.

questions.q: What is the moment of inertia of a solid cylinder of mass M and radius R about its central geometrical axis?
questions.explanation: The moment of inertia of a solid cylinder (or a uniform disc) about its central axis is 1/2 MR².

questions.q: For an object in pure rolling motion, the velocity of the point of contact with the surface is:
questions.explanation: In pure rolling (rolling without slipping), the instantaneous velocity of the point of contact with the ground is zero.

questions.q: The moment of inertia of a uniform rod of mass M and length L about an axis passing through its center and perpendicular to its length is ML²/12. What is its moment of inertia about an axis passing through one of its ends and perpendicular to its length?
questions.explanation: Using Parallel Axis Theorem: I = I_cm + Md². Here, d = L/2. So, I = ML²/12 + M(L/2)² = ML²/12 + ML²/4 = ML²/3.
